QUOTE: "Option A: compile time (no runtime indirection)... MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO... Option B: runtime. Define only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, then call this before any Mbed TLS allocation: mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the compile-time macro pair and the runtime function-pointer setter. It never says the two are mutually exclusive. Its table even shows the macros being layered on top of `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, and the answer doesn't say that setting the macros disables the runtime setter.
